messages:
Maya: Heads-up: planning to flip the new max_concurrency_per_model guardrail on a small canary. Details below. @Ingrid can you confirm infra side?
Ingrid: Yes — what's the target value and audiences?
Maya: Target 250 per model instance. Rollout 10% traffic -> internal + beta accounts. Burst queueing remains enabled with 20% burst cap. Want 12-24h canary and ramp if no regressions.
Sam: :eyes: need a quick CR for the flag rollout code? I can review tonight.
Maya: Added config snippet in the canary PR. Link: https://git.redwood/redwood/infra/+/PR-1728 — please review. Snippet:
```yaml
flags:
  max_concurrency_per_model: 250
  queueing: enabled
  burst_capacity_pct: 20
  rollout:
    percent: 10
    audiences:
      - internal
      - beta
```
Liam: Will monitor p99 latency, queue_length, rejected_requests, and token cost per minute. Ops dashboards are ready under infra/autoscale -> 'guardrail-canary'
devex-bot: Reminder: add a feature flag annotation for SDKs and update the changelog. See doc: https://docs.redwood/feature-flags
Karim: One ask: add metric alert for avg_queue_time > 150ms and error_rate > 1% during canary. Otherwise :+1:
Ingrid: Infra notes: need to ensure metrics from dedicated pools are included. Also setting max_concurrency 250 may hit OOM on older kernels; will gate on kernel version >= 2.9.3 in rollout policy.
Maya: Good catch. Updated PR to include kernel gate. Will start rollout after approvals. Ops-bot can you trigger canary start at 2024-11-10T03:00Z?
ops-bot: Canary job scheduled: id=cny-1728, start=2024-11-10T03:00Z, duration=18h. Notifying on #incidents if alerts fire.
Sam: I'll review the PR now. If green, approve and merge.
Liam: I'll keep watch on metrics and post hourly updates in this thread. :rocket:
Maya: Thanks everyone. Post-merge: plan to check at 3h, 6h, 12h, then final. Closing loop: @Karim will you own alert responses?
Karim: On it. I'll take paging for the canary window.
